user_story: As a customer on https://www.saucedemo.com, I want to open a product's detail page and return to the catalogue so that I can keep browsing. Acceptance criteria: after logging in with 'standard_user' / 'secret_sauce', clicking the first product name '.inventory_item_name' navigates to a URL containing 'inventory-item.html'; clicking the back button [data-test="back-to-products"] returns to a URL containing '/inventory.html' with the '.title' element showing 'Products'.
